evidence: C4 is within ~2mm of U2, but the +3V3 decoupling pair C5/C6 sits ~8mm from U2 and the +5V rail cap C2 is ~10mm from the L1/buck output, far beyond the few-mm adjacency requirement.
The chain reads strictly left-to-right (J1 input -> C1/C3 -> U1 buck -> D1/L1 -> C2 -> J2) with the 3V3 branch (U2 -> C5/C6 -> J3) continuing rightward/upward, with no doubling back across the group.
Straight pad-to-pad ratsnest lines from J1 to the input caps, J2 to C2, and J3 to C5/C6 run roughly parallel and converge without any pair crossing in the 2D view.
Power flows in placement order from J1 input through input caps C1/C3 to buck U1, then L1/C2 to the 5V load side, with C4 on the input side of LDO U2 and outputs J2/J3 at the far end.
